Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
English model: @tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz.
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
The three LSTM-only WebAssembly-in-JavaScript builds support standard, SIMD,
and relaxed SIMD browsers. createWorker('eng', 1) exclusively uses LSTM mode.
Worker, engine and English data load from this site. OCR stays in the browser.
